product_family: Social media management and scheduling platform (publishing, bulk scheduling, content calendar, team collaboration/approvals, review management, analytics/reporting) with tiers for individuals, small teams, agencies, and a White Label reseller offering. Includes an optional add-on feature, AI Pilot, for AI-assisted content generation.

certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of AI-management-system certification found on the vendor's domain.

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of a CSA STAR registration or certification on the vendor's domain.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No HIPAA claim, Business Associate Agreement (BAA) offer, or HIPAA-specific control language found on any SocialPilot-domain page. Third-party marketplace listings note SocialPilot's HIPAA status must be verified directly with the vendor, which we could not confirm on-domain.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of PCI DSS certification found; SocialPilot does not appear to directly process cardholder data itself (billing is handled via a payment processor, not disclosed by name on the pages reviewed).

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of FedRAMP authorization found on the vendor's domain.

certifications.name: GDPR (posture)
certifications.proof_quote: The policy explicitly references compliance with GDPR, UK GDPR, CCPA, CPRA, and PIPEDA; states data is transferred outside the EEA 'only when there has been a documented adequacy determination'; and offers a Data Processing Addendum with Model (Standard Contractual) Clauses for EEA data transfers to non-adequate countries.

privacy.ai_training_note: SocialPilot's Google API Disclosure page states verbatim: 'SocialPilot does not use Google Workspace APIs to develop, improve, or train generalized AI or ML models.' This confirmed no-training commitment is scoped specifically to Google Workspace API data (a mandatory Google API Services disclosure), not a blanket guarantee covering all customer content processed elsewhere in the product, including the AI Pilot content-generation feature. No vendor-domain page makes a general statement about whether AI Pilot itself trains on customer-entered prompts/content or is limited to third-party model inference; broader trains_on_customer_data is therefore recorded as unknown (null) rather than assumed false.
privacy.data_region: Not disclosed on any vendor-domain page reviewed (no hosting provider or region named in the Trust Center, Privacy Policy, or DPA).

security.name: Encryption in transit and at rest
security.value: SOC 2 Type 2 audit scope explicitly names 'data encryption in transit and at rest' as an audited control.

security.name: Access control
security.value: Role-specific access management for sensitive information, cited as an audited SOC 2 control.

security.name: Authentication
security.value: Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) and Single Sign-On (SSO) listed as recent security initiatives.

security.name: Incident response / breach notification
security.value: Data Processing Addendum commits to notifying customers of a personal data breach without undue delay, and in any case within 72 hours of becoming aware.

security.value: DPA requires at least 14 days' advance notice of new/changed subprocessors, with a 10-day customer objection window, and requires subprocessors to meet standards substantially similar to the DPA.

security.name: Monitoring

compare.pricing_model: Tiered subscription SaaS (per-user/per-account plans: Professional, Small Team, Studio/Agency, plus a White Label reseller tier); no free self-serve enterprise tier disclosed on pages reviewed

flags: SOC 2 Type 2 certification is referenced on a dedicated vendor-domain marketing page and corroborated by the vendor's Trust Center and an independent press release. The signed audit report is gated behind a lead-generation form (name/email request); exact audit period, auditor firm name, and report scope beyond the marketing description are not publicly disclosed.

The 'no AI/ML training' commitment on the vendor's Google API Disclosure page is scoped only to Google Workspace API data, not to all customer content, and is not a blanket 'SocialPilot never trains AI on customer data' claim.

A third-party automated rating site (WeControl, not the vendor) gave SocialPilot a 0/5 'GDPR-friendly' score, which conflicts with the vendor's own GDPR-referencing Privacy Policy and Standard Contractual Clauses DPA published on its domain.
No HIPAA, PCI DSS, ISO 27001, or AI-governance (ISO 42001 / CSA STAR) certifications were found.
Data hosting provider/region is not disclosed anywhere on the vendor's own site pages.
